page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c4g1.xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.gn5i server family. Running on the KVM hypervisor, this instance features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores, resulting in a single thread per core configuration. The system is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per CPU core.

For hardware acceleration, the instance includes a single NVIDIA P4 GPU with 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage is not bundled with this server type, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external block storage volumes. Network connectivity is defined by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps, and the instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a resource density perspective, this instance offers an entry-level GPU-to-CPU ratio, making it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for workloads that require GPU acceleration without demanding massive parallel computing resources. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance. This hardware profile is suited for workloads such as low-concurrency inference, media transcoding, basic machine learning model evaluation, and lightweight GPU-accelerated graphics rendering.
